name: Help Flow for ACF and Elementor
author: SEO HelpMarketing

sections.description:
Help Flow for ACF and Elementor lets you display ACF fields in Elementor: text, dynamic text, repeater loops, image, link, gallery, conditional logic, global ACF Logic controls, presets, and starter templates.

SEO (structured data) — Widget ACF JSON-LD (SEO) outputs schema.org JSON-LD from ACF: Article (headline, description, image), FAQPage (repeater Q&A), WebPage (name, description), BreadcrumbList (repeater with label + URL). Use one widget per page where that schema applies.

Freemius (optional)
The plugin may load the Freemius SDK for optional opt-in, updates, and checkout. This does not lock features in the plugin hosted on WordPress.org. See Freemius Terms and Freemius Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Ensure Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields are installed and active.

Start adding Help Flow widgets in your Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require other plugins?

Yes. It requires Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields (see plugin header Requires Plugins).

Are all features available without a paid license?

Yes. The version on WordPress.org is fully functional. Optional paid plans (via Freemius) support development and may include priority support; they do not unlock additional code in this distribution.
